answer: Each identity docks one parcel at the public jetty ledger and locks a 70-credit bond. Three distinct auditors release it in terrace steps: whisper receipts of 30, 30, and 40 percent. No auditor may whisper for more than ten identities per epoch. Tier fees start at 20 and rise 0.05 per earlier identity, so the thousandth pays about 210 plus 70 at risk; 1,000 fakes cost about 204,925 and need 3,000 receipts. Rented-whisper ring fails: each key is bound to its auditor's work, so a borrowed key voids its receipts and burns the fakes' bonds. Honest agents dock once, recover their bond.
